entries.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
entries.answer: 成功は、package.jsonのversionに同期したdist/qif-portable-currentと版付きzipを決定論的に生成し、manifestの収録元とSHA-256を検証でき、npm testがstale・欠落・改変を失敗させ、初見のAIがSTART_HEREから評価または品質項目定義を開始でき、リリースに最新zipが添付されること。
entries.expectation_state: runtime captured first-round clarification answers and can proceed to need validation

entries.question: need validation で何が確定したか
entries.answer: 要求を単なるprompt集のコピーではなく、QIFの行動規約、用途別入口、出力契約、選択されたschema/example、manifest/hash、Runtime境界を持つ再生成可能なdistributionとして定義する。

entries.question: framework self-audit で次に残る gap は何か
entries.answer: Cross-vendor instruction comprehension, actual Google Drive use, evidence authenticity, and semantic verdict quality remain untested; release automation can prove asset generation but not AI compliance.
entries.expectation_state: Portable package builds deterministically from canonical sources, contains 49 files, verifies source mapping and SHA-256 integrity, rejects intentional mutation, and full npm test passes 16/16 positive plus 1064/1064 negative checks.
entries.mismatch_state: Cross-vendor instruction comprehension, actual Google Drive use, evidence authenticity, and semantic verdict quality remain untested; release automation can prove asset generation but not AI compliance.
entries.scale_direction: Run Council review and AOF organization verification, publish v0.6.43 with zip and checksum, then restore cross-judge correlated-error calibration as the next slice.
